You are Australia, building ships

Project 63 · a shipyard, kind shipyard · play: you are Australia · index · repo randomcase/you-are-australia-building-ships

a shipyard game, with the three hulls it is measured against

Australia went to Vietnam with a task force, a lottery draft, and a navy of destroyers on the gunline — HMAS Hobart, Perth, Brisbane and Vendetta took turns off the coast, and Hobart was hit by a US aircraft's missiles in 1968. It has never built a carrier of its own; it bought two from Britain and retired the last, Melbourne, in 1982. The game is what it would take.

You are Australia. Tap to cut steel; every hull you lay down cuts steel for you, at the rate its yard would; the bigger the hull, the more it costs and the more it returns, and the supercarrier is priced at what it is. There is no enemy. The only thing to beat is the table above.
